newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Healthcare Tech okays Gamidor purchase.
newsitem.headline: Healthcare Tech okays Gamidor purchase.

text.p: Shareholders of Israel's Healthcare Technologies Ltd approved the acquisition of Gamidor and its subsidiary Gamidor Diagnostics for 23.5 percent of Healthcare's share capital and $2.1 million in cash.
Healthcare said in a statement on Monday it agreed to pay another six million shekels by the year 2,000 if Gamidor's operating profits in this period rise above an agreed level.
Gamidor had sales of $10 million in 1996, similar to Healthcare's level.
The acquisition, which is subject to the closing of a definitive agreement as well as the approval of Israeli regulatory authorities, is expected to take place within two weeks.
Gamidor distributes and markets laboratory equipment in the biotechnology, chemical and medical fields.
Healthcare develops and manufactures diagnostic testing kits for various diseases.
